kind: must-be-deep
depth: deep
reason: deep-provider-config
-- base/main.tf --
provider "aws" {
  alias  = "west"
  region = "us-west-2"
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name = var.name
}

variable "name" {
  type = string
}
-- head/main.tf --
provider "aws" {
  alias  = "east"
  region = "us-west-2"
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name = var.name
}

variable "name" {
  type = string
}
